news.title: SpaceX sends classified US spy satellites to orbit in early-morning launch from California coast (video)
paras: The NROL-136 mission delivered a batch of spacecraft for the National Reconnaissance Office's "proliferated architecture" constellation. 22), on the NROL-136 mission out of California.

A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base's Launch Complex-4E at 7:23 a.m. It was the sixth National Reconnaissance Office launch (NROL) this year to deliver a payload, or group of payloads, to low Earth orbit , all which have been carried out by SpaceX 's workhorse Falcon 9. The launch marks another step in the NRO's effort to expand its intelligence-gathering capabilities through a proliferated network of spacecraft designed to provide more frequent and timely surveillance of locations around the globe.

sport.title: Every word Carlos Alcaraz said after winning the ATP Finals including his message for Alexander Zverev
paras: Carlos Alcaraz is the new champion of the ATP Finals after a hard-fought victory over Alexander Zverev. Alcaraz loves playing in front of Italian tennis fans , who have just witnessed the Spaniard clinch the ATP Finals title in Turin for the very first time.

He defeated Zverev 6-2, 7-6(9-7) in an entertaining final, which lasted just over two hours. Zverev has made huge strides this season , but the world number one couldn’t cap off his stunning 2026 by claiming a third ATP Finals success. Instead, his Spanish rival has lifted the trophy for the first time in his career, going one step further than his runner-up finish in 2025.

sport.title: Head, Heart And Balls: Carlos Alcaraz Follows Grandpa’s Advice To Win First ATP Finals Title
paras: Carlos Alcaraz has ended Spain’s 28-year wait for an ATP Finals champion after dismissing a misfiring Alexander Zverev in straight sets. The Spaniard battled his way to a 6-2, 7-6(7) win over an out-of-sorts Zverev, who produced 31 unforced errors compared to 12 winners.

Alcaraz, who is currently on a 14-match winning streak, has become only the fourth player in history to have won every Grand Slam event and the ATP Finals. Andre Agassi, Roger Federer and Novak Djokovic are the others to have achieved this milestone. Alcaraz showed no sign of physical issues throughout the final.

sport.title: Alexander Zverev has kind message for Carlos Alcaraz after losing the ATP Finals: ‘You’re an absolute legend’
paras: Alexander Zverev was unable to beat Carlos Alcaraz in the final of the ATP Finals. Zverev was beaten by Alcaraz 6-2, 7-6(7), despite having three consecutive set points in the second set tie-break.

This is the first time that Zverev has lost in the final of the ATP Finals , having won the title in both 2018 and 2021, and continued his winless record against both Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner this year. After finishing as runner-up at the ATP Finals, Zverev had a message for Alcaraz in his post-match speech on court in Turin.

paras: One year after losing the final to Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals for the first time on Sunday in Turin, beating world No. 1 Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7) in 2 hours and 2 minutes.
